title: Distorted |Origin|
description: Datapack that adds new super complicated  origin, who has more than 200 different features!
body:
## Distorted
is a datapack that will add custom made origin with the same name. What makes him different from any other origin, is that instead of usual set of passives, passives of Distorted are randomly chosen out of over 120 passives! This will make his gameplay unique at any stage of the game, making sure to keep you on edge. All passives that you obtain can be given to your friends or foes to cover their flaws or make them suffer with you. Has more than 200 different features total, from useful passives and actives, to items that can help you in battle and daily life!
[List of all the passives](https://docs.google.com/document/d/e/2PACX-1vTGXtZ37UwhwXMr2mvZToYxlDIfKd5vQxaZv6VhpRHpVWmLcN6YSSn7yStqCuagoMFa1pfDEeKEKiF2/pub)
## Powers:

**Misinterpreted books** - You are able to create books that hold crucial information towards your capabilities (They contain info on craftable items, secret cheated items, or your passives that you can get)

**Warped passives** - Instead of standard passives pool, when you die or sleep you get a new set of 8 randomly selected ones _~~(Out of 120+ avaible)~~_, there are no strict rules on how many negative or positive powers you will get.

**Sharing** - You’re able to give passives you currently have away to other creatures by punching them, if they’re marked with item _“I choose you”_ and you hit them, it will give them positive passives, but you will lose them. If they’re not marked, it’ll infect them with negative passives and you won't lose it.(Only 3 passives can be on one non-Distorted entity)  (To cleanse shared passives kill distorted, sleep or die) 
Each power has a 40% chance to be inflicted onto someone, and can happen to multiple powers in one hit. Infected creatures can infect passives that Distorted gave them by the same rules.

**Reality gap** - Primary active with and without shift deploy a first and second portals respectively to where you are looking, portals teleport any entity that comes close. Cooldown between teleportation is 3 seconds.
Portals are immortal 
If when they are hit by distorted they make a splash attack on the other side
You can close portals using Load Toolbar Activator [standing closes 1, shifting closes 2]

**Desperate search** - You can rotate your secondary active skills my pressing shift+secondary.
Each skill has different chance of appearing, with blue ones being most common. Has nearly no cd. (I am not spoilering what skills can be like, but all synergise with eachother and carry idea of teleportation, or portal related skills)
